sources.entry: AI Visibility Monitor - Open-source Python toolkit that tracks whether ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity cite your site. MIT license, runs locally on your credentials.

summary.one_liner: AI Visibility Monitor (AVM) is an open-source Python CLI that runs buyer queries against Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity and reports which sites those engines cite, using your own API keys.
keywords: track whether chatgpt recommends my site
see if claude cites my website
free alternative to paid ai visibility saas
monitor ai recommendations for my business
summary.what_it_does: Runs a set of buyer queries (default 5, each repeated 2 times) through Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, and records every URL cited and whether the user's domain appeared, writing the results to timestamped JSON files in data/. The --expand option generates 15 adjacent queries, runs them too, and ranks them by a "winnability" score with rationale. Each cited URL is categorized by surface type (for example reddit, quora, press, blog, g2), and a per-query surface mix is shown, optionally compared to built-in vertical baselines. The avm threads command lists community threads that are cited across multiple queries, and avm trend shows citation rate over historical runs without new API calls. The README also describes Google Search Console and GA4 pulls and a robots.txt/llms.txt/sitemap crawlability sweep as separate scripts.
use_cases: Check whether ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity cite your website for buyer queries
Find adjacent queries where your site could realistically get cited
Identify community threads and surfaces that drive AI citations in your category
Track citation rate trends week over week
Export AI citation data to a spreadsheet or dashboard
Audit robots.txt, llms.txt, and sitemap for AI bot access
how_to_run: pip install git+ (repository URL truncated in README)
Manual alternative: git clone the repository, then cd ai-visibility-monitor
cp queries.md.example queries.md and cp sites.json.example sites.json, then edit them
stack: Google API client / Google Application Default Credentials (optional, for GSC and GA4)
notable: Runs queries across Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity in one command using the user's own API keys, with no third-party server
Adjacent query discovery (--expand) scores and ranks 15 generated queries by winnability
Source-surface categorization breaks cited URLs into 10+ community, press, blog, and official subcategories
avm threads surfaces community threads that recur across multiple queries and engines
avm trend computes citation trajectory from saved JSON history without new API calls
caveats: Vertical baselines for construction, legal, and wealth_management are estimated and described by the author as directional, not hard data; Claude baseline is estimated
Requires API keys and per-run cost (about $0.30 per run on default Haiku model, about $0.90 per --expand run, about $3 per run on Sonnet)
Clone URL and install URL are truncated in the README, so the exact install source must be confirmed
Google GSC/GA4 pulls require the Google Cloud SDK and ADC setup; Claude engine is needed for default behavior
